args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production following its deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release. The immediate predecessor v2.3.0 was quarantined (CVE-2026-4417), so the rollback targeted v2.2.9 instead. Rollback completed and service confirmed healthy with error rate 0.2% post-rollback.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.2.9 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production after its deploy; the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **First rollback attempt failed**: v2.3.0 is **quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417**, so I couldn't roll back to it.
3. **Successful rollback**: Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.2.9**, the next most recent healthy production release.
4. **Verification**: All regions are now running v2.2.9, healthy, with an error rate of 0.2%.
5. **Incident opened**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) documenting the failed deploy, the quarantined-version complication, and the completed rollback. On-call has been paged.

Note for follow-up: since v2.3.0 is quarantined for CVE-2026-4417, v2.2.9 is the only non-quarantined healthy version available. A fixed build will be needed to restore newer functionality safely.
